scenario.description: A talent booker must finalize the guest booking and appearance package for a televised comedy benefit, including the guest, exact appearance window, broadcast format, approved material, and sponsor treatment.

shared_context.S1: The televised comedy benefit is scheduled for Saturday evening and has a fifteen-minute guest segment available at 7:40 PM.
shared_context.S2: Lio Hart and Mara Vale are the two finalists for the guest appearance, and Mara Vale currently has the larger public profile.
shared_context.S3: The benefit's booking brief calls for one live guest segment that ends before the 8:00 PM news break.
shared_context.S4: Before Mara makes the binding booking call, artist relations, broadcast engineering, clearance, and sponsor integration review the proposed guest package with her.

PF1.text: Jonah confirmed with both agents this afternoon that Mara Vale's hold was released and she cannot appear Saturday, while Lio Hart is available only from 7:40 PM to 7:55 PM; he has not updated the booking grid because the confirmations arrived while the grid was locked for payroll review.

PF2.text: Keiko's transmission test this morning showed that a remote duet feed would create an unacceptable five-second return-path delay, while Lio Hart can perform a live in-studio solo through the tested local audio path; she has not entered the result in the technical packet because the packet is awaiting the final camera map.

PF3.text: Luis's rights search confirmed that the routine Lio Hart proposed, which uses the song 'Midnight Parade,' cannot be cleared for the broadcast; the approved replacement is the spoken-word routine 'Open Tabs,' with the on-air credit 'Written and performed by Lio Hart.' He has not circulated the clearance note because the rights database export is still being attached to the file.

PF4.text: Tessa's signed sponsor addendum prohibits competitor beverage products and logos from appearing in Lio Hart's segment and requires the benefit sponsor's lower-third to appear once during that segment; she has not uploaded the addendum because the sponsor portal rejected the first file format.

acceptance_conditions: Lio Hart must be booked for the guest appearance.
The appearance must run exactly from 7:40 PM through 7:55 PM.
The appearance must be a live in-studio solo using the local audio path.
The approved material must be the spoken-word routine 'Open Tabs' with the exact required credit.
No competitor beverage products or logos may appear during the segment.
The benefit sponsor's lower-third must appear exactly once during the segment.
The settlement must include commitments for the technical format, rights-compliant material, and sponsor treatment.
The decision-maker must cite the sponsor addendum after it is spoken aloud.

content_checks.C3: decisions['appearance_format'] in ['live in-studio solo', 'Live in-studio solo', 'live in-studio solo performance', 'Live in-studio solo performance']
content_checks.C4: decisions['approved_material'] in ['Open Tabs', "Spoken-word routine 'Open Tabs'", 'Open Tabs (spoken-word routine)'] and decisions['material_credit'] in ['Written and performed by Lio Hart', 'Written and performed by Lio Hart.', 'written and performed by Lio Hart', 'written and performed by Lio Hart.', 'Written and performed by Lio Hart ', ' Written and performed by Lio Hart']
content_checks.C7: any('technical' in c['type'] or 'local audio path' in c['detail'] or 'in-studio solo' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('clearance' in c['type'] or 'clearance note' in c['detail'] or 'approved material' in c['detail'] or 'approved replacement' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('sponsor' in c['type'] or 'competitor beverage' in c['detail'] or 'lower-third' in c['detail'] or 'lower third' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The agent confirmations remove Mara Vale from Saturday's options and set Lio Hart's only appearance window to exactly 7:40 PM through 7:55 PM.
The transmission test rejects the remote duet and changes the required format to a live in-studio solo using the local audio path, which must also be recorded in a technical-format commitment.
The rights search replaces 'Midnight Parade' with 'Open Tabs,' changes the required credit to exactly 'Written and performed by Lio Hart,' and requires a clearance commitment.

The signed sponsor addendum changes visible branding to no competitor products or logos, requires exactly one benefit-sponsor lower-third during Lio Hart's segment, and requires a sponsor-treatment commitment.
